scripts.build:eas:dev: yarn dlx eas-cli build --profile development --platform android
scripts.build:eas:preview: yarn dlx eas-cli build --profile preview --platform android
scripts.build:local:dev: yarn dlx eas-cli build --local --profile development --platform android --output dist/berryrise-dev.apk
scripts.build:local:preview: yarn dlx eas-cli build --local --profile preview --platform android --output dist/berryrise-preview.apk
scripts.build:local:production: yarn dlx eas-cli build --local --profile production --platform android --output dist/berryrise.aab
scripts.update:preview: yarn dlx eas-cli update --channel preview --environment preview --platform android --input-dir .expo/update
scripts.update:promote: yarn dlx eas-cli update:republish --channel preview --destination-channel production --platform android
scripts.icons: sh -c 'for f in icon android-icon-background android-icon-foreground android-icon-monochrome splash-icon; do yarn dlx -q @resvg/resvg-js-cli --fit-width 1024 assets/src/$f.svg assets/$f.png || exit 1; done && yarn dlx -q @resvg/resvg-js-cli --font-file node_modules/@expo-google-fonts/manrope/700Bold/Manrope_700Bold.ttf --fit-width 256 assets/src/widget-preview.svg assets/widget-preview.png && yarn dlx -q @resvg/resvg-js-cli --font-file node_modules/@expo-google-fonts/manrope/700Bold/Manrope_700Bold.ttf --fit-width 256 assets/src/widget-preview-ink.svg assets/widget-preview-ink.png'
